verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ሞተ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ወተስእሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ [ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡] እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ መኑ
                  ፡ የዐርግ ፡ ለነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ከናኔዎን ፡ መልአክ ፡ ዘይትቃተሎሙ ፡ ለነ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after the death of Joshua, that the children of Israel enquired of the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us first against the Chananites, to fight against them?

translations.lxx: And it came to pass after the death of Joshua, that the children of Israel enquired of the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us first against the Chananites, to fight against them?
translations.kjv: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
translations.ron: După moartea lui Iosua, au întrebat fiii lui Israel pe Domnul, zicând: "Cine din noi să meargă mai întâi asupra Cananeenilor, ca să se lupte cu ei?"
translations.grk: ΚΑΙ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὴν τελευτὴν Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἐπηρώτων οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου, λέγοντες, τίς ἀναβήσεται ἡμῖν πρὸς τοὺς Χαναναίους ἀφηγούμενος τοῦ πολεμῆσαι πρὸς αὐτούς;

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ[ሙ] ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ የዐርግ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ አግባእክዋ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said, Judas shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said, Judas shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul: "Iuda să meargă şi Eu voi da ţara în mâna lui!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος, Ἰούδας ἀναβήσεται· ἰδοὺ δέδωκα τὴν γῆν ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ለስምዖን ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ዕረግ ፡ ምስሌየ ፡ በውስተ ፡ መክፈልትየ ፡ ወንትቃተሎሙ ፡ ለከናአን ፡ ወአሐውር
                  ፡ አነኒ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ መክፈልትከ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ስምዖን ፡ ምስሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And Judas said to his brother Symeon, Come up with me into my lot, and let us array ourselves against the Chananites, and I also will go with thee into thy lot: and Symeon went with him.

translations.lxx: And Judas said to his brother Symeon, Come up with me into my lot, and let us array ourselves against the Chananites, and I also will go with thee into thy lot: and Symeon went with him.
translations.kjv: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
translations.ron: Iuda a zis către Simeon, fratele său: "Intră cu mine în ţinutul care mi-a căzut la sorţi şi să ne luptăm cu Cananeenii şi voi intra şi eu cu tine în ţinutul care ţi-a căzut la sorţi". Şi s-a dus Simeon cu el.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰούδας τῷ Συμεὼν ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ, ἀνάβηθι μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ κλήρῳ μου, καὶ παραταξώμεθα πρὸς τοὺς Χαναναίους, καὶ πορεύσομαι κᾀγὼ μετὰ σοῦ ἐν τῷ κλήρῳ σου· καὶ ἐπορεύθη μετʼ αὐτοῦ Συμεών.

verses.geez:
ወዐርገ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወአግብኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለከናኔዎን ፡ ወለፌሬዜዎን ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወቀተሎሙ ፡ በቤዜቅ ፡
                  እልፈ ፡ ብእሴ ።
verses.translation: And Judas went up; and the Lord delivered the Chananite and the Pherezite into their hands, and they smote them in Bezek to the number of ten thousand men.

translations.lxx: And Judas went up; and the Lord delivered the Chananite and the Pherezite into their hands, and they smote them in Bezek to the number of ten thousand men.
translations.kjv: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a dus Iuda cu Simeon şi Domnul a dat pe Cananeeni şi pe Ferezei în mâinile lor şi au ucis ei din aceia zece mii de oameni în Bezec.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβη Ἰούδας· καὶ παρέδωκε Κύριος τὸν Χαναναῖον καὶ τὸν Φερεζαῖον εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν· καὶ ἔκοψαν αὐτοὺς ἐν Βεζὲκ εἰς δέκα χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν·

verses.geez: ወረከብዎ ፡ ለአዶኒቤዜቅ ፡ ወተቃተልዎ ፡ ወቀተልዎሙ ፡ ለከናኔዎን ፡ ወለፌሬዜዎን ።
verses.translation: And they overtook Adonibezek in Bezek, and fought against him; and they smote the Chananite and the Pherezite.

translations.lxx: And they overtook Adonibezek in Bezek, and fought against him; and they smote the Chananite and the Pherezite.
translations.kjv: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
translations.ron: Şi s-au întâlnit ei în Bezec cu Adoni-Bezec şi s-au bătut cu dânsul şi au răpus pe Canaanei şi pe Ferezei.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέλαβον τὸν Ἀδωνιβεζὲκ ἐν τῇ Βεζὲκ, καὶ παρετάξαντο πρὸς αὐτόν· καὶ ἔκοψαν τὸν Χαναναῖον καὶ Φερεζαῖον.

verses.geez: ወጐየ ፡ አዶኒቤዜቅ ፡ ወዴገንዎ ፡ ወተለውዎ ፡ ወአኀዝዎ ፡ ወመተሩ ፡ አርእስተ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ወእገሪሁ ።
verses.translation: And Adonibezek fled, and they pursued after him, and took him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

translations.lxx: And Adonibezek fled, and they pursued after him, and took him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
translations.kjv: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
translations.ron: Iar Adoni-Bezec a fugit; dar ei au alergat după el şi l-au prins şi i-au tăiat degetele mari de la mâini şi de la picioare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔφυγεν Ἀδωνιβεζέκ· καὶ κατέδραμον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάβοσαν αὐτὸν, καὶ ἀπέκοψαν τὰ ἄκρα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ἄκρα τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ አዶኒቤዜቅ ፡ ዘ፸ነገሥት ፡ አርእስተ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ወእገሪሆሙ ፡ ምቱር ፡ ሀለወ ፡ አስተጋብኡ ፡ በታሕተ ፡
                  ማእድየ ፡ ወበከመ ፡ ገበርኩ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ፈደየኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወወሰድዎ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ወሞተ ፡ በህየ ።
verses.translation: And Adonibezek said, Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their food under my table: as I therefore have done, so God has recompensed me: and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

translations.lxx: And Adonibezek said, Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their food under my table: as I therefore have done, so God has recompensed me: and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
translations.kjv: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
translations.ron: Atunci Adoni-Bezec a zis "Şaptezeci de regi cu degetele cele mari tăiate de la mîinile şi de la picioarele lor adunau fărîmituri sub masa mea; cum am făcut eu, aşa mi-a plătit şi mie Dumnezeu". Şi l-au adus în Ierusalim şi a murit acolo.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἀδωνιβεζὲκ, ἑβδομήκοντα βασιλεῖς, τὰ ἄκρα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἄκρα τῶν ποδῶν αὐτῶν ἀποκεκομμένοι, ἦσαν συλλέγοντες τὰ ὑποκάτω τῆς τραπέζης μου· καθὼς οὖν ἐποίησα, οὕτως ἀνταπέδωκέ μοι ὁ Θεός. καὶ ἄγουσιν αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ, καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez:
ወተቃተሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ወአስተግብእዋ ፡ ወቀተልዋ ፡ በአፈ ፡ ኀፂን ፡ ወአውዐዩ ፡ ሀገራ ፡
                  በእሳት ።
verses.translation: And the children of Judas fought against Jerusalem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and they burnt the city with fire.

translations.lxx: And the children of Judas fought against Jerusalem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and they burnt the city with fire.
translations.kjv: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
translations.ron: Apoi au mers fiii lui Iuda cu război asupra Ierusalimului şi l-au luat şi l-au trecut prin sabie, iar cetatea au dat-o focului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπολέμουν υἱοὶ Ἰούδα τὴν Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ κατελάβοντο αὐτὴν, καὶ ἐπάταξαν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ῥομφαίας, καὶ τὴν πόλιν ἐνέπρησαν ἐν πυρί.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ ፡ ወረዱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ይትቃተልዎሙ ፡ ለከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ።
verses.translation: And afterwards the children of Judas went down to fight with the Chananite dwelling in the hill country, and the south, and the plain country.

translations.lxx: And afterwards the children of Judas went down to fight with the Chananite dwelling in the hill country, and the south, and the plain country.
translations.kjv: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
translations.ron: După aceea s-au dus fii lui Iuda să se lupte cu Canaaneii care trăiau în munţi, în ţara de miazăzi şi în părţile de jos.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα κατέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰούδα πολεμῆσαι πρὸς τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα τὴν ὀρεινὴν καὶ τὸν Νότον καὶ τὴν πεδινήν.

verses.geez:
ወሖረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኬብሮን ፡ ወወፅኡ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኬብሮን ፡ ተቀበልዎሙ ፡
                  ወስማ ፡ ለኬብሮን ፡ ትካት ፡ ቀሪየርቦቀሴፌር ፡ ወቀተልዎሙ ፡ ለሴሲ ፡ ወለአኪመም ፡ ወለተሚ ፡ ትውልደ ፡ ኤነቅ ።
verses.translation: And Judas went to the Chananite who dwelt in Chebron; and Chebron came out against him; [and the name of Chebron before was Cariatharbocsepher:] and they smote Sessi, and Achiman, and Tholmi, children of Enac.

translations.lxx: And Judas went to the Chananite who dwelt in Chebron; and Chebron came out against him; [and the name of Chebron before was Cariatharbocsepher:] and they smote Sessi, and Achiman, and Tholmi, children of Enac.
translations.kjv: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
translations.ron: Şi a mers Iuda asupra Cananeilor care locuiau în Hebron; iar numele Hebronului era mai înainte Chiriat-Arba; şi a bătut pe Şeşai, pe Ahiman şi pe Talmai, din neamul lui Enac.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ἰούδας πρὸς τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Χεβρών· καὶ ἐξῆλθε Χεβρὼν ἐξ ἐναντίας· καὶ τὸ ὄνομα ἦν Χεβρὼν τὸ πρότερον Καριαθαρβοκσεφέρ· καὶ ἐπάτάξαν τὸν Σεσσὶ καὶ Ἀχιμὰν καὶ Θολμὶ γεννήματα τοῦ Ἐνάκ.

verses.geez: ወሖሩ ፡ እምህየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ዳቢር ፡ ወስማ ፡ ለዳቢር ፡ ትካት ፡ ሀገረ ፡ መጽሐፍ ።
verses.translation: And they went up thence to the inhabitants of Dabir; but the name of Dabir was before Cariathsepher, the city of Letters.

translations.lxx: And they went up thence to the inhabitants of Dabir; but the name of Dabir was before Cariathsepher, the city of Letters.
translations.kjv: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:
translations.ron: Iar de acolo s-au dus împotriva locuitorului Debirului al cărui nume era mai înainte Chiriat-Sefer.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐκεῖθεν πρὸς τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δαβίρ· τὸ δὲ ὄνομα τῆς Δαβὶρ ἦν ἔμπροσθεν Καριαθσεφὲρ, πόλις Γραμμάτων.

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ ካሌብ ፡ ዘቀተላ ፡ ለሀገረ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ወአስተጋብኣ ፡ እሁቦ ፡ አስካ ፡ ወለትየ ፡ ትኩኖ ፡ ብእሲተ ።
verses.translation: And Chaleb said, Whosoever shall smite the city of Letters, and shall first take it, I will give to him Ascha my daughter to wife.

translations.lxx: And Chaleb said, Whosoever shall smite the city of Letters, and shall first take it, I will give to him Ascha my daughter to wife.
translations.kjv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
translations.ron: Atunci Caleb a zis: "Cine va lovi Chiriat-Seferul şi-l va lua, aceluia îi voi da pe Acsa, fiica mea, de femeie".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Χάλεβ, ὃς ἂν πατάξῃ τὴν πόλιν τῶν Γραμμάτων καὶ προκαταλάβηται αὐτὴν, δώσω αὐτῷ τὴν Ἀσχὰ θυγατέρα μου εἰς γυναῖκα.

verses.geez:
ወአስተጋብኣ ፡ ጎቶኒየል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ቄኔዝ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለካሌብ ፡ ዘይንእስ ፡ ወወሀቦ ፡ አስካ ፡ ወለቶ ፡ ትኩኖ ፡
                  ብእሲቶ ።
verses.translation: And Gothoniel the younger son of Kenez the brother of Chaleb took it; and Chaleb gave him his daughter Ascha to wife.

translations.lxx: And Gothoniel the younger son of Kenez the brother of Chaleb took it; and Chaleb gave him his daughter Ascha to wife.
translations.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
translations.ron: Şi l-a luat Otniel, fiul lui Chelaz, fratele mai mic al lui Caleb, şi acesta i-a dat de soţie pe Acsa, fiica sa.
translations.grk: Καὶ προκατελάβετο αὐτὴν Γοθονιὴλ υἱὸς Κενὲζ ἀδελφοῦ Χάλεβ ὁ νεώτερος· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ Χάλεβ τὴν Ἀσχὰ θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ εἰς γυναῖκα.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ለሐዊራ ፡ አምከራ ፡ ጎቶኒየል ፡ ትስአሎ ፡ ለአቡሃ ፡ ይጸግዋ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ወፍር ፡ ወአንጐርጐረት ፡ በዲበ ፡
                  አድግ ፡ ወጸርሐት ፡ በላዕለ ፡ አድግ ፡ ወትቤ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ አዜብ ፡ ፈኖከኒ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ካሌብ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ኮንኪ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass as she went in, that Gothoniel urged her to ask a field of her father; and she murmured and cried from off her ass, Thou hast sent me forth into a south land: and Chaleb said to her, What is thy request?

translations.lxx: And it came to pass as she went in, that Gothoniel urged her to ask a field of her father; and she murmured and cried from off her ass, Thou hast sent me forth into a south land: and Chaleb said to her, What is thy request?
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
translations.ron: Şi când a vrut ea să plece, Otniel a învăţat-o să ceară de la tatăl ei o ţarină şi ea s-a coborât de pe asin. Şi i-a zis Caleb: "Ce vrei?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ εἰσόδῳ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπέσεισεν αὐτὴν Γοθονιὴλ τοῦ αἰτῆσαι παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς ἀγρόν· καὶ ἐγόγγυζε καὶ ἔκραζεν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὑποζυγίου, εἰς γῆν Νότου ἐκδέδοσαί με· καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Χάλεβ, τί ἐστί σοι;

verses.geez:
ወትቤሎ ፡ አስካ ፡ ሀበኒ ፡ በረከተ ፡ እስመ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ አዜብ ፡ ፈኖከኒ ፡ ወሀበኒ ፡ ቤዛ ፡ ማይ ፡ ወወሀባ ፡ ካሌብ
                  ፡ በከመ ፡ ትፈቱ ፡ በልባ ፡ ቤዛ ፡ ሕሙም ፡ ወቤዛ ፡ ትኩዝ ።
verses.translation: And Ascha said to him, Give me, I pray thee, a blessing, for thou hast sent me forth into a south land, and thou shalt give me the ransom of water: and Chaleb gave her according to her heart the ransom of the upper springs and the ransom of the low springs.

translations.lxx: And Ascha said to him, Give me, I pray thee, a blessing, for thou hast sent me forth into a south land, and thou shalt give me the ransom of water: and Chaleb gave her according to her heart the ransom of the upper springs and the ransom of the low springs.
translations.kjv: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
translations.ron: Iar Acsa a zis către el: "Dă-mi binecuvîntare: tu mi-ai dat pământul de la miazăzi, dă-mi şi izvoarele de apă". Şi i-a dat Caleb, după dorinţa ei, izvoarele cele de sus şi izvoarele cele de jos.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀσχὰ, δὸς δή μοι εὐλογίαν, ὅτι εἰς γῆν Νότου ἐκδέδοσαί με, καὶ δώσεις μοι λύτρωσιν ὕδατος· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῇ Χάλεβ κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῆς λύτρωσιν μετεώρων καὶ λύτρωσιν ταπεινῶν.

verses.geez:
ወደቂቀ ፡ ዮባብ ፡ ቀኔያዊ ፡ ሐሙሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ዐርጉ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ፊንቆን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ሐቅለ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ አዜብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሙራደ ፡ አረድ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Jothor the Kenite the father-in-law of Moses went up from the city of palm-trees with the children of Judas, to the wilderness that is in the south of Juda, which is at the descent of Arad, and they dwelt with the people.

translations.lxx: And the children of Jothor the Kenite the father-in-law of Moses went up from the city of palm-trees with the children of Judas, to the wilderness that is in the south of Juda, which is at the descent of Arad, and they dwelt with the people.
translations.kjv: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
translations.ron: Iar fii lui Hobab cheneul, socrul lui Moise, au mers din cetatea Palmierilor cu fii lui Iuda în pustiul lui Iuda din Negheb, care este la miazăzi de Arad şi, venind, s-au aşezat între Amaleciţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰοθὸρ τοῦ Κιναίου τοῦ γαμβροῦ Μωυσῆ ἀνέβησαν ἐκ πόλεως τῶν φοινίκων μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰούδα εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τὴν οὖσαν ἐν τῷ Νότῳ Ἰούδα, ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ καταβάσεως Ἀρὰδ, καὶ κατῴκησαν μετὰ τοῦ λαοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወሖረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ስምዖን ፡ [እኁሁ ፡] ወቀተልዎሙ ፡ ለከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሴፍር ፡
                  ወአሕረምዋ ፡ ወአጥፍእዋ ።
verses.translation: And Judas went with Symeon his brother, and smote the Chananite that inhabited Sepheth, and they utterly destroyed them; and they called the name of the city Anathema.

translations.lxx: And Judas went with Symeon his brother, and smote the Chananite that inhabited Sepheth, and they utterly destroyed them; and they called the name of the city Anathema.
translations.kjv: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
translations.ron: Apoi a mers Iuda cu Simeon, fratele său şi a lovit pe Canaaneii care locuiau în Ţefat şi i-au dat pieirii; de aceea s-a numit cetatea aceea Horma.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ἰούδας μετὰ Συμεὼν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔκοψε τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα Σεφὲθ, καὶ ἐξωλόθρευσαν αὐτους· καὶ ἐκάλεσε τὸ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως, Ἀνάθεμα.

verses.geez: ወኢተወርሳ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ለጋዛን ፡ ወለደወላ ፡ ወአስቃሎና ፡ ወደወላ ፡ ወአዛጦን ፡ ወደወላ ፡ ወጺኦታቲሃ ።
verses.translation: But Judas did not inherit Gaza nor her coasts, nor Ascalon nor her coasts, nor Accaron nor her coasts, nor Azotus nor the lands around it.

translations.lxx: But Judas did not inherit Gaza nor her coasts, nor Ascalon nor her coasts, nor Accaron nor her coasts, nor Azotus nor the lands around it.
translations.kjv: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
translations.ron: Şi a mai luat Iuda şi Gaza cu împrejurimile ei, Ascalonul cu împrejurimile lui şi Ecronul cu ţinutul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἐκληρονόμησεν Ἰούδας τὴν Γάζαν οὐδὲ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῆς, οὐδὲ τὴν Ἀσκάλωνα οὐδὲ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Ἀκκαρὼν οὐδὲ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῆς, τὴν Ἄζωτον οὐδὲ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወሀለወ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወተወርሰ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ወስእነ ፡ ተወርሶቶሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ቈላት ፡ እስመ ፡ ሬከብ ፡ ፈለጣ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord was with Judas, and he inherited the mountain; for they were not able to destroy the inhabitants of the valley, for Rechab prevented them.

translations.lxx: And the Lord was with Judas, and he inherited the mountain; for they were not able to destroy the inhabitants of the valley, for Rechab prevented them.
translations.kjv: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
translations.ron: Şi a fost Domnul cu Iuda şi acesta a luat în stăpânire partea muntoasă; dar pe locuitorii din vale nu i-a putut alunga pentru că ei aveau care de fier.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦν Κύριος μετὰ Ἰούδα· καὶ ἐκληρονόμησε τὸ ὄρος, ὅτι οὐκ ἠδυνάσθησαν ἐξολοθρεῦσαι τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν κοιλάδα, ὅτι Ῥηχὰβ διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez:
ወወሀብዎ ፡ ለካሌብ ፡ ኬብሮን ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወተወርሰ ፡ እምህየ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ወአሰሰሎሙ ፡ እምህየ ፡
                  ለሠለስቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤናቅ ።
verses.translation: And they gave Chebron to Chaleb, as Moses said; and thence he inherited the three cities of the children of Enac.

translations.lxx: And they gave Chebron to Chaleb, as Moses said; and thence he inherited the three cities of the children of Enac.
translations.kjv: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
translations.ron: Şi au dat lui Caleb Hebronul, cum zisese Moise, şi a primit el acolo de moştenire cele trei cetăţi ale fiilor lui Enac şi a alungat pe cei trei fii ai lui Enac.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκαν τῷ Χάλεβ τὴν Χεβρὼν, καθὼς ἐλάλησε Μωυσῆς· καὶ ἐκληρονόμησεν ἐκεῖθεν τὰς τρεῖς πόλεις τῶν υἱῶν Ἐνάκ.

verses.geez:
ወለኢየቡሴዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ኢያሰሰልዎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ብንያሚ ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ኢየቡሴዎን ፡
                  ምስለ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ብንያሚ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: But the children of Benjamin did not take the inheritance of the Jebusite who dwelt in Jerusalem; and the Jebusite dwelt with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem until this day.

translations.lxx: But the children of Benjamin did not take the inheritance of the Jebusite who dwelt in Jerusalem; and the Jebusite dwelt with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem until this day.
translations.kjv: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
translations.ron: Iar fii lui Veniamin n-au alungat pe Iebuseii care locuiau în Ierusalim; şi trăiesc Iebuseii cu fii lui Veniamin în Ierusalim pînă în ziua de astăzi.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν Ἰεβουσαῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ οὐκ ἐκληρονόμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Βενιαμίν· καὶ κατῴκησεν ὁ Ἰεβουσαῖος μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμὶν ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης.

verses.geez: ወዐርጉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዮሴፍሰ ፡ እሙንቱኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቴል ፤
verses.translation: And the sons of Joseph, they also went up to Bæthel; and the Lord was with them.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Joseph, they also went up to Bæthel; and the Lord was with them.
translations.kjv: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.
translations.ron: S-au suit de asemenea şi fii lui Iosif asupra Betelului şi Domnul a fost cu ei,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰωσὴφ καί γε αὐτοὶ εἰς Βαιθήλ· καὶ Κύριος ἦν μετʼ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወስማ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ትካት ፡ ሉዛ ።
verses.translation: And they encamped and surveyed Bæthel: and the name of the city before was Luza.

translations.lxx: And they encamped and surveyed Bæthel: and the name of the city before was Luza.
translations.kjv: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
translations.ron: Şi s-au oprit ei şi au cercetat Betelul; iar numele cetăţii acesteia era mai înainte Luz.
translations.grk: Καὶ παρενέβαλον, καὶ κατεσκέψαντο Βαιθήλ· τὸ δὲ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως ἦν ἔμπροσθεν Λουζά.

verses.geez:
ወርእዩ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ መዓቅብ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ወአኀዝዎ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ አርእየነ ፡ ምብዋኣ
                  ፡ ለሀገር ፡ ወንገብር ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ምሕረተ ።
verses.translation: And the spies looked, and behold, a man went out of the city, and they took him; and they said to him, Shew us the way into the city, and we will deal mercifully with thee.

translations.lxx: And the spies looked, and behold, a man went out of the city, and they took him; and they said to him, Shew us the way into the city, and we will deal mercifully with thee.
translations.kjv: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
translations.ron: Şi au văzut cei de strajă un om ieşind din cetate şi l-au prins şi i-au zis: "Arată-ne intrarea cetăţii şi vom avea milă de tine"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδον οἱ φυλάσσοντες, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἐξεπορεύετο ἐκ τῆς πόλεως, καὶ ἔλαβον αὐτόν· καὶ εἶπον αὐτῷ, δεῖξον ἡμῖν τῆς πόλεως τὴν εἴσοδον, καὶ ποιήσομεν μετὰ σου ἔλεος.

verses.geez:
ወአርአዮሙ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይበውእዋ ፡ ለሀገር ፡ ወቀተልዋ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ሀገር ፡ በአፈ ፡ ኀፂን ፡ ወለዝክቱሰ ፡
                  ብእሲ ፡ ወለአዝማዲሁ ፡ አግዐዝዎሙ ።
verses.translation: And he shewed them the way into the city; and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and his family.

translations.lxx: And he shewed them the way into the city; and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and his family.
translations.kjv: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
translations.ron: Şi le-a arătat intrarea cetăţii şi ei au lovit cetatea cu sabia, iar omului aceluia şi la tot neamul lui i-au dat drumul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς πόλεως· καὶ ἐπάταξαν τὴν πόλιν ἐν στόματι ῥομφαίας· τὸν δὲ ἄνδρα καὶ τὴν συγγένειαν αὐτοῦ ἐξαπέστειλαν.

verses.geez:
ወአተወ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ኬጤዎን ፡ ወነደቀ ፡ በህየ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ወሰመየ ፡ ስማ ፡ ሉዛ ፡ ወውእቱ
                  ፡ ኮነ ፡ ስማ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ።
verses.translation: And the man went into the land of Chettin, and built there a city, and called the name of it Luza; this is its name until this day.

translations.lxx: And the man went into the land of Chettin, and built there a city, and called the name of it Luza; this is its name until this day.
translations.kjv: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
translations.ron: Şi s-a dus omul acela în pământul Heteilor şi a zidit acolo o cetate şi i-a pus numele Luz. Şi acesta este numele ei pînă în ziua de astăzi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὁ ἀνὴρ εἰς γῆν Χεττίν· καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ πόλιν, καὶ ἐκάλεσε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Λουζά· τοῦτο ὄνομα αὐτῆς ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης.

verses.geez:
ወኢተወርሰ ፡ ምናሴ ፡ ቤተሳን ፡ እንተ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ሶቂቶን ፡ ወኢአዋልዲሃ ፡ ወኢጺኦታቲሃ ፡ ወኢኤቅዳአድ ፡ ወኢአዋልዲሃ
                  ፡ ወኢእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዶር ፡ ወኢአዋልዲሃ ፡ ወኢእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ [ውስተ] ፡ በለዓም ፡ ወኢአዋልዲ[ሃ] ፡ ወኢእለ
                  ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጌዶን ፡ ወኢአዋልዲሃ ፡ ወኢእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ [ውስተ ፡] የብለዓም ፡ ወኢአዋልዲሃ ፡ ወአኀዙ ፡
                  ከናአን ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: And Manasse did not drive out the inhabitants of Bæthsan, which is a city of Scythians, nor her towns, nor her suburbs; nor Thanac, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Dor, nor her towns; nor the inhabitant of Balac, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Magedo, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Jeblaam, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; and the Chananite began to dwell in this land.

translations.lxx: And Manasse did not drive out the inhabitants of Bæthsan, which is a city of Scythians, nor her towns, nor her suburbs; nor Thanac, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Dor, nor her towns; nor the inhabitant of Balac, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Magedo, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Jeblaam, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; and the Chananite began to dwell in this land.
translations.kjv: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
translations.ron: Manase de asemenea n-a alungat pe locuitorii Bet-Şeanului, care e Schitopole, şi ai cetăţilor supuse lui, nici pe ai Taanacului şi ai cetăţilor supuse lui, nici pe locuitorii din Dor şi ai cetăţilor supuse lui, nici pe locuitorii Ibleamului şi ai cetăţilor supuse lui, nici pe locuitorii Meghidonului şi ai cetăţilor supuse lui; şi au rămas Canaaneii să trăiască în pământul acesta.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἐξῇρε Μανασσῆ τὴν Βαιθσὰν, ἥ ἐστι Σκυθῶν πόλις, οὐδὲ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς οὐδὲ τὰ περίοικα αὐτῆς, οὐδὲ τὴν Θανὰκ οὐδὲ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς, οὐδὲ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δὼρ οὐδὲ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς, οὐδὲ τὸν κατοικοῦντα Βαλὰκ οὐδὲ τὰ περίοικα αὐτῆς οὐδὲ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς, οὐδὲ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Μαγεδὼ οὐδὲ τὰ περίοικα αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς, οὐδὲ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ἰεβλαὰμ οὐδὲ τὰ περίοικα αὐτῆς, οὐδὲ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῆς· καὶ ἤρξατο ὁ Χαναναῖος κατοικεῖν ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ጸንዑ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ መጸብሔ ፡ ረሰይዎሙ ፡ ለከናአን ፡ ወአጥፍኦሰ ፡ ኢያጥፍእዎሙ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when Israel was strong, that he made the Chananite tributary, but did not utterly drive them out.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when Israel was strong, that he made the Chananite tributary, but did not utterly drive them out.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
translations.ron: Cînd Israel a ajuns puternic, atunci a făcut pe Canaanei birnici, dar de izgonit nu i-a izgonit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐνίσχυσεν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἐποίησε τὸν Χαναναῖον εἰς φόρον, καὶ ἐξαίρων οὐκ ἐξῇρεν αὐτόν.

verses.geez:
ወኤፍሬምኒ ፡ ኢያጥፍእዎሙ ፡ ለከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጋዜር ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ከናኔዎን ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ውስተ
                  ፡ ጋዜር ፡ ወኮንዎሙ ፡ መጸብሔ ።
verses.translation: And Ephraim did not drive out the Chananite that dwelt in Gazer; and the Chananite dwelt in the midst of him in Gazer, and became tributary.

translations.lxx: And Ephraim did not drive out the Chananite that dwelt in Gazer; and the Chananite dwelt in the midst of him in Gazer, and became tributary.
translations.kjv: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
translations.ron: Nici Efraim n-a izgonit pe Canaaneii care locuiau în Ghezer, şi au trăit Canaaneii în mijlocul lor şi le-au plătit lor bir.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἐφραὶμ οὐκ ἐξῇρε τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Γαζέρ· καὶ κατῴκησεν ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτοῦ ἐν Γαζὲρ, καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς φόρον.

verses.geez:
ወዛቡሎንሂ ፡ ኢያጥፍእዎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቄድሮን ፡ ወለእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐማን ፡ ወነበሩ ፡
                  ከናኔዎን ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ወኮንዎሙ ፡ መጸብሔ ።
verses.translation: And Zabulon did not drive out the inhabitants of Kedron, nor the inhabitants of Domana: and the Chananite dwelt in the midst of them, and became tributary to them.

translations.lxx: And Zabulon did not drive out the inhabitants of Kedron, nor the inhabitants of Domana: and the Chananite dwelt in the midst of them, and became tributary to them.
translations.kjv: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
translations.ron: Zabulon încă n-a izgonit pe locuitorii Chitronului şi pe locuitorii Nahalolului; şi au locuit Canaaneii în mijlocul lor şi le-au plătit bir.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ζαβουλὼν οὐκ ἐξῇρε τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Κέδρων, οὐδὲ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δωμανά· καὶ κατῴκησεν ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ εἰς φόρον. Καὶ Ἀσὴρ οὐκ ἐξῇρε τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δωμανά· καὶ κατῴκησεν ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ εἰς φόρον.

verses.geez:
ወአሴርሂ ፡ ኢያጥፍእዎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አኮ ፡ ወኮንዎሙ ፡ መጸብሔ ፡ ወእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደር
                  ፡ ወእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲዶና ፡ ወእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዳላፍ ፡ ወአስኮድ ፡ ወኬድያ ፡ ወአፌቅ ፡ ወሮዖብ ።
verses.translation: And Aser did not drive out the inhabitants of Accho, and that people became tributary to him, nor the inhabitants of Dor, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor the inhabitants of Dalaph, nor Aschazi, nor Chebda, nor Nai, nor Ereo.

translations.lxx: And Aser did not drive out the inhabitants of Accho, and that people became tributary to him, nor the inhabitants of Dor, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor the inhabitants of Dalaph, nor Aschazi, nor Chebda, nor Nai, nor Ereo.
translations.kjv: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
translations.ron: Nici Aşer n-a izgonit pe locuitorii din Aco care-i plăteau bir, nici pe locuitorii din Dor, nici pe locuitorii din Sidon şi Mahaleb, din Aczib, din Helba, din Afec şi din Rehob.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἀσὴρ οὐκ ἐξῇρε τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ἀκχὼ, καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ εἰς φόρον, καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δὼρ, καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Σιδῶνα, καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δαλὰφ, τὸν Ἀσχαζὶ, καὶ τὸν Χεβδὰ, καὶ τὸν Ναῒ, καὶ τὸν Ἐρεώ.

verses.geez: ወነበረ ፡ አሴር ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ እስመ ፡ ስእኑ ፡ አጥፍኦቶሙ ።
verses.translation: And Aser dwelt in the midst of the Chananite who inhabited the land, for he could not drive him out.

translations.lxx: And Aser dwelt in the midst of the Chananite who inhabited the land, for he could not drive him out.
translations.kjv: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
translations.ron: Şi a locuit Aşer între Canaanei, locuitorii ţării aceleia, căci nu i-a izgonit.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατῴκησεν ὁ Ἀσὴρ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Χαναναίου τοῦ κατοικοῦντος τὴν γῆν, ὅτι οὐκ ἠδυνήθη ἐξάραι αὐτόν.

verses.geez:
ወንፍታሌምሂ ፡ ኢያጥፍእዎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤ[ተ ፡] ሳሚስ ፡ ወኢእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቴኔት ፡
                  ወነበሩ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ሀለዉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወኮንዎሙ ፡ መጾብሔ ፡ እለ ፡
                  ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ሳሚስ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ቤቴኔክ ።
verses.translation: And Nephthali did not drive out the inhabitants of Bæthsamys, nor the inhabitants of Bæthanach; and Nephthali dwelt in the midst of the Chananite who inhabited the land: but the inhabitants of Bethsamys and of Bætheneth became tributary to them.

translations.lxx: And Nephthali did not drive out the inhabitants of Bæthsamys, nor the inhabitants of Bæthanach; and Nephthali dwelt in the midst of the Chananite who inhabited the land: but the inhabitants of Bethsamys and of Bætheneth became tributary to them.
translations.kjv: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
translations.ron: Nici Neftali n-a izgonit pe locuitorii din Bet-Şemeş, nici pe locuitorii din Bet-Anat, şi a trăit între Canaanei, locuitorii ţării aceleia. Iar locuitorii din Bet-Şemeş şi din Bet-Anat erau birnicii lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ Νεφθαλὶ οὐκ ἐξῇρε τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Βαιθσαμῦς, καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Βαιθανάχ· καὶ κατῴκησε Νεφθαλὶ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Χαναναίου τοῦ κατοικοῦντος τὴν γῆν· οἱ δὲ κατοικοῦντες Βαιθσαμὺς καὶ τὴν Βαιθενὲθ, ἐγένοντο αὐτοῖς εἰς φόρον.

verses.geez:
ወአጠቅዎሙ ፡ አሞሬዎን ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ዳን ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢያበውሕዎሙ ፡ ይረዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቈላት ፡
                  ወአኅዙ ፡ አሞሬዎን ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ መርስኖኖስ ፡ ዘቦ ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡ ድበ ፡ ወቈናጽለ ፡ ወጸንዐት ፡ እዴሁ ፡
                  ለቤተ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አሞሬዎን ፡ ወኮንዎሙ ፡ መጸብሔ ።
verses.translation: And the Amorite drove out the children of Dan into the mountain, for they did not suffer them to come down into the valley.

translations.lxx: And the Amorite drove out the children of Dan into the mountain, for they did not suffer them to come down into the valley.
translations.kjv: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
translations.ron: Dar Amoreii au împins pe fii lui Dan în munţi şi nu i-a lăsat să se coboare în vale.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξέθλιψεν ὁ Ἀμοῤῥαῖος τοὺς υἱοὺς Δὰν εἰς τὸ ὄρος, ὅτι οὐκ ἀφῆκαν αὐτὸν καταβῆναι εἰς τὴν κοιλάδα.

verses.geez: ወደብረ ፡ አሞሬዎን ፡ (ለ)ኢዱሜዎን ፡ ላዕላይ ፡ ዘአቅራቢን ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ [ላዕለ ፡] ኰኵሕ ።
verses.translation: And the Amorite began to dwell in the mountain of shells, in which are bears, and foxes, in Myrsinon, and in Thalabin; and the hand of the house of Joseph was heavy upon the Amorite, and he became tributary to them.

translations.lxx: And the Amorite began to dwell in the mountain of shells, in which are bears, and foxes, in Myrsinon, and in Thalabin; and the hand of the house of Joseph was heavy upon the Amorite, and he became tributary to them.
translations.kjv: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
translations.ron: Şi au rămas Amoreii să locuiască în Har-Heres, în Aialon şi Şaalbim; dar mîna fiilor lui Iosif a răpus pe Amorei şi au ajuns aceştia birnicii lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤρξατο ὁ Ἀμοῤῥαῖος κατοικεῖν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ ὀστρακώδει, ἐν ᾧ αἱ ἅρκτοι καὶ ἐν ᾧ αἱ ἀλώπεκες, ἐν τῷ Μυρσινῶνι, καὶ ἐν Θαλαβίν, καὶ ἐβαρύνθη ἡ χεὶρ οἴκου Ἰωσὴφ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἀμοῤῥαῖον, καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτοῖς εἰς φόρον.
